# Committed .ct files that the current readers refuse, and why.
#
# verify-all-recordings.sh checks every other committed .ct with both trace
# readers. A file listed here must still be refused by BOTH, and only for its
# container version; one that opens fails the check, so its line is removed
# rather than left to hide a later regression.
#
# Format: <path><TAB><reason>
mcr/android-arm64/trace.ct	container version 3; re-recorded only on a USB-connected Android device (mcr/android-arm64/regenerate.sh)
mcr/android-arm64/trace-portable.ct	container version 3; exported from android-arm64/trace.ct, which must be re-recorded first
mcr/ios-arm64/trace.ct	container version 3; re-recorded only on macOS with Xcode and an iOS simulator (mcr/ios-arm64/regenerate.sh)
mcr/ios-arm64/trace-portable.ct	container version 3; exported from ios-arm64/trace.ct, which must be re-recorded first
tools/ctfs-v4-to-v5/testdata/null_main.v4.ct	container version 4 on purpose: the original of eme5/null_main.ct, which tools/ctfs-v4-to-v5 converts
tools/ctfs-v4-to-v5/testdata/one_puts.v4.ct	container version 4 on purpose: the original of eme5/one_puts.ct, which tools/ctfs-v4-to-v5 converts
